guide.summary: A dark green alga that keeps growing even in dim light.
guide.biology: Some real algae carry extra light-catching pigments that let them make food in shady water.
guide.rules: Lives in water only and does not swim. Turns carbon dioxide into half body and half sugar, releasing oxygen, like Sunbead. Its light response is min(1, light ÷ 0.30): it works at full speed from light 0.30 upward, and brighter light gives no extra growth. Its top intake is lower than Sunbead's (0.10 carbon per second instead of 0.16), and so is its upkeep (0.30 energy per second). Needs mineral nutrients. Prey for Amoeba, Ciliate, Rotifer, Waterbear and Wheelgrazer.
guide.example: Paint shade over half the dish and compare Shadeleafs and Sunbeads in the dark half and in the bright half.
